hint.idle: This app is not running. Click “Start & embed” and it will appear right here.
hint.running: Its window is running but not embedded yet. Click “Re-embed” to take it over.
hint.missing: No executable found. Install the app first, or use “Add app” to pick an .exe by hand.
hint.error: Could not take over its window. The reason and the windows that process owns are below; a slow starter such as an IDE may need a minute or two the first time.
hint.note: Embedding takes over the app's own native window: leaving this page hides it (the app keeps running) and closing the workbench gives the window back to the desktop.

kill.title: Close app
kill.message: This ends every {{name}} process. Unsaved work may be lost.

remove.title: Remove app
remove.message: Remove {{name}} from this list? Nothing is uninstalled or deleted.
